emptyTitle: Pick a repository to get started
emptyBody: GitScribe reads the working tree of any local git repository, then drafts a conventional commit message — with an optional AI pass for a sharper summary.
untrackedNote: {count} untracked file(s) are not shown in the diff below.
commitHint:
feat(auth): add login screen

Draft locally or with AI, then review and commit.
draftedMessage: Drafted a commit message from the current changes.
needApiKey: Add an API key in Settings first, then try again.
noChangesToDraft: There are no changes to draft from.
aiDraftReady: AI draft ready — review it before committing.
missingGitIdentity: Git identity is missing. Run `git config --global user.name` and `git config --global user.email` first.
authFailed: Git authentication failed. GitScribe does not prompt for or retry credentials — resolve it in your terminal, then try again.
gitNotFound: `git` was not found on PATH. GitScribe relies on the system git and does not bundle its own.
diffLimitInvalid: Diff limit must be a non-negative integer.
settingsFootnote: GitScribe uses your system git and never prompts for credentials — authentication failures are shown as-is.
stageCommitBody: Combine into a single commit or split into several, then choose the commit style.
splitNote: Each group becomes a separate commit.
multiCommitHint: AI can split this into multiple commits
multiNotImplemented: Multi-commit splitting arrives in the next stage.
multiAutoHint: Let AI decide how to split
manualNotImplemented: Manual grouping arrives in the next stage.
splitFormatError: AI returned an invalid format. Please try again.
splitDegradedToSingle: AI decided no split is needed; treated as a single commit.
